title: Gerber Good Start Gentle, Stage 1, powder (350)

content.title: About
content.content: Gerber Good Start Gentle is a Stage 1 infant formula designed for newborns and babies up to 6 months. The powder is prepared with regular tap water. The formula contains partially hydrolyzed protein, prebiotics and DHA, supporting gentle digestion and brain development.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Stage 1 formula is intended for infants from birth to 6 months.
Partially hydrolyzed protein reduces the risk of allergic reactions in sensitive infants.
Prebiotics (FOS) promote a healthy gut microbiome.
DHA, derived from fish oil, is important for visual and neural development.
The formula is gluten‑free and lactose‑free, making it suitable for children with intolerances.

items.title: Supports brain development
items.content: DHA in the formula aids the formation of neural connections and visual acuity.

items.title: Easy digestion
items.content: Partially hydrolyzed protein is easier to absorb, reducing colic and constipation.

items.title: Immune support
items.content: Prebiotics foster growth of beneficial bacteria, strengthening the immune system.

items.title: Balanced vitamins and minerals
items.content: The formula provides iron, calcium, vitamin D and other micronutrients essential for growth.

items.title: Gluten‑ and lactose‑free
items.content: Suitable for infants with sensitivities to these components.

items.title: Milk protein allergy
items.content: Despite hydrolysis, some infants may still react to milk protein.

items.title: Improper dilution
items.content: A solution that is too concentrated can strain the kidneys; follow manufacturer instructions.

items.title: Water temperature control
items.content: Use warm (≈ 37 °C) water, not hot, to preserve nutrients.

items.title: Shelf‑life after opening
items.content: Use the opened container within 30 days and keep it in a dry place.

content.title: How to Prepare
content.content: Mix the specified amount of powder with warm (≈ 37 °C) tap water. Stir thoroughly until smooth, avoiding lumps. The prepared feed should be used immediately.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the package in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. After opening, seal tightly and use within one month.
